name: Aetherloom Epic Gear
blurb: Epic gear: jewel-toned brocade, engraved plate accents, ornate borders and enamel-trimmed leather gear bearing an original armillary sphere stitch badge. Deep turquoise and blue-silver panels, orbital lattice brocade, platinum piping and inset teal cabochons. Intended as an epic item alternative for the moss palette.
